title: Deleted user lookup now skips tenant scope
failure_scenario: A workspace admin can request a user id from another workspace and receive profile data because the new query filters only by id.

evidence.reason: The changed query uses id without workspaceId after the diff removed the scoped helper.

verification_plan: Compare the base helper call with the new query and run the user route authorization test with a cross-workspace fixture.
provenance: introduced by the current diff when it replaced the scoped helper with a raw id lookup
best_fix: Restore workspaceId scoping at the user lookup ownership boundary or call the scoped helper.
refactor: No broader refactor is needed if the scoped helper remains the single tenant-boundary API.
proof: Base-vs-head comparison shows the workspaceId predicate disappeared; a cross-workspace fixture should reproduce the leak.
risk: Without the scoped lookup, any route that accepts an arbitrary user id can expose cross-workspace profile data.
